opening.argument: Start with how the material identifies itself: the article is explicitly labeled advertorial, separate from editorial content. It promotes Orbeon as an investment platform and directs readers to buy its tokens, while also discussing cryptocurrency market conditions. Those are visible promotional and market-analysis claims, not evidence by themselves of deceptive conduct. The accompanying disclaimer calls the material opinion rather than financial advice and says no particular outcome is guaranteed. The purchase invitation warrants attention, but the supplied material does not establish deception, investor losses, or a promised result.
